_about: Elsewhere Annex v2 (ET · Gremlin Desks only). The world is procedural: a seeded grid of cells. Each section has a crystal plaza at its 'center' cell; every other cell belongs to the nearest section and gets hallways (always safe) plus rooms off them (where grabbers and the rare almost-people live). To add a section: copy a row in 'sections', give it a new id, center [cellX, cellZ] a few cells from the others, palette, crystal and room mix. Cells are grid.cell metres square.
name: The Elsewhere Annex
tagline: The Gremlins found it. They're still mapping it.

lore.grenshol: Deep in the Annex the Gremlins found a portal. They poked it, prodded it, licked it (of course) and generally tried to figure out what it was. Something tall and curious came out. Its name is Grenshol. It isn't mad about it. It just wants to know what everything is, especially you.
lore.firstSighting: A gremlin note, taped to nothing: "we opened a portal to see what it was. something tall came out. it's called Grenshol. it seems nice?? if it catches you it shows you where it came from. if YOU catch IT, it lets you look around."

clues._future: Lore-clue system (NOT built yet). Collectible clue notes about Grenshol, the portal and the Gremlins' mistake. Planned row shape: {id, title, text, section, cell:[di,dj], quad, requires:{clues:n}?}. Planned behaviour: spawn like curiosities, show under a 'Clues' tab in Pockets, save to progress.clues (same localStorage key, later the Desks database).

notes.title: Survey page, torn
notes.text: Day 3. Found a round thing in the wall. It hums in B flat. Pip says it's a portal. Grimble says it's a very confident puddle.

characters._future: Character/stats system (NOT built yet). Players would get a few stats (rolled or chosen) and some doors would ask for a dice roll against one. Planned: progress.character = {stats:{nerve,luck,curiosity,knack}}, diceDoors rows {id, section, cell:[di,dj], quad, stat, dc, dice, success:{to, text}, fail:{to, text}}. A failed roll never hurts; it just sends you somewhere sillier.

stats.name: Nerve
stats.about: walking toward the tall thing anyway

success.text: The door clicks open onto somewhere damp and pleasant.

fail.text: The door opens onto… the start. The Gremlins applaud politely.

grid._about: cell = size of one generated block (m). hall = corridor width. Chunks within loadRadius cells of you are built; beyond unloadRadius they're thrown away. spokes = corridors forced open out of each crystal plaza. npcMinDepth = almost-people never appear closer than this many cells to the entrance.

goal.message: Three curiosities! The Gremlins scribble on their survey: "they're getting the hang of it." The sewn-shut stitch in the Soft Stockroom plaza has come undone.

entrances.label: The Loose Stitch
entrances.notes: Main entrance. Off-center on the gallery back wall, between art 2 and 3; away from the Cat House swirl, notice board and Gremlin World door.

entrances.label: A very small loose stitch
entrances.notes: Secret. Low in the back corner of Bryan's office, on the wall to the LEFT when facing his desk. Anyone who finds it and answers the riddle can use it.

entrances.label: A door that wasn't there yesterday

office-stitch.title: The stitch whispers…
office-stitch.prompt: Say the word that found this place.
office-stitch.success: Aha. That's the word. The stitch loosens and pulls you through…
wrong: Nope. The stitch giggles and sews itself a little tighter.
Wrong word. Somewhere a gremlin is laughing into a stapler.
The thread says: "that's not what found me."
Not even close. A tiny voice behind the wall goes "pfft."
Denied. The stitch pretends to be a crack in the paint.
office-stitch._todo: Bryan will write the real riddle. Change prompt + answers only; matching is trimmed and case-insensitive.

homeCrystal.name: Home crystal
homeCrystal.given: The Gremlins pressed a little 🏠 home crystal into your hand. Squeeze it any time to go back to the start.
homeCrystal.used: The home crystal tugs a thread and reels you back to the start.
fizzle: 🫧 Your home crystal fizzles like flat soda. Something about this spot. Walk a little and try again.
🫧 Pfft. The crystal makes a sad kazoo noise. No signal here.
🫧 The crystal just… shrugs. A gremlin note nearby says "we tried. we licked it. nothing."

lostHint: Lost? Good, that's the fun part. Your 🏠 home crystal still works (mostly).

sections.name: The Wrong Print

shift.warning: The hum changes pitch… somewhere nearby, rooms are swapping places.
shift.done: Something shifted. The Wrong Print isn't quite the same shape now.

shift.done: Something shifted. The Annex That Turns isn't quite the same shape now.

sections.blurb: Shelves that back away from you. Vending machines with no buttons.

shift.warning: Cardboard creaks… the aisles are rearranging.

sections.name: The Waiting Floor

shift.warning: A ticket machine dings… the floor is rearranging.

shift.done: Something shifted. The pools are somewhere else now.

sections.blurb: Most of the lights are off. Somebody is still working late.

shift.warning: A desk lamp clicks off… the night shift is rearranging.
shift.done: Something shifted. The night shift moved the furniture again.

npcPrompts: Have you seen the way out?

reprint: Good mor-mor-morning, {nameOff}. Did you bring the, the, the.
Hello? Hello? Hel. Lo. (it smiles one second late)
Hi! You look exactly like you, mostly.
The way out is filed under 'way out.' I am filed under 'in.'
Out is just in, but printed backwards.
Ask the red chair. It knows the turn.
This is the office. The good copy. The other one is the copy.
Toner. Mostly toner. And carpet. Damp carpet.
It's where the paper goes when the tray says 'jam.'
Nice to meet you too too too.
We've met. You were taller. Or I was.
onhold: Please continue to remain. Your call is impor— hello?
Mmm-hmm. Mmm-hmm. (it is not talking to you)
Transferring you to the way out. (the hold music gets slightly louder)
Your plant called. It will be late.
Press 3 for the exit. There is no 3.
You've reached the Annex. All of our hallways are currently turning.
This is the department of the same right turn.
It's a call center, but the calls are hallways.
Thank you for your patience. Your patience is very nice.
unfiled: Hello is in the wrong folder.
Oh! You're a page. No. You're a person. Close.
Try the stitch by the vending machine. It hums when it's ready.
Please initial the air, then leave.
The stockroom. Everything that didn't get used lives here.
A drawer. A big one. You're in it.
It's where 'I'll put it somewhere safe' ends up.
Nice is filed under N. Meet is under M. I can't find 'to.'
We should do lunch. Lunch is in the box marked 'boxes.'
Sorting you… sorted. (it puts you nowhere)
echohire: Hi! I'm {nameOff}! I'm new! Have we met? I'm new.
Welcome to the team! I'm also new. We're both new forever.
Hello! You must be me. I mean you.
Great question! Let me show you the exit. (points at a blank wall) Isn't it lovely?
The way out is on the tour! Stop 14. There are 3 stops.
Out? Oh, we don't do out. We do onboarding.
This is the gallery! Here is a painting. (the frame is empty) And here is another one.
This is the Annex! The Gremlins found it. They didn't hire me. I just showed up.
It's the office, but for later.
Nice to meet you, {nameOff}! That's my name too. Probably.
So nice! Let's get coffee in the room that isn't there.
I'll add you to the group chat. The group chat is a hallway.
late: …(it's still answering something nobody asked yet)
Oh! Hi. Sorry. Hi. Hello. Was that already?
Yes, hello. Hi. (it's answering your last question)
Out? Out was yesterday. I was late for it.
The way out left without me. It said it'd wait.
This place? It's the meeting. You're early. I'm late. Same room.

bounceback.telegraph: Flump. Flump. Something soft is coming…
bounceback.caught: The Bounceback gave you a big squishy hug and spat you out right by the crystal in {section}.

misfire._about: Waystone travel sometimes lands in a random OTHER section (unvisited ones first). Per-crystal misfireChance overrides chance.
messages: Whoops. The waystone sneezed. You're… not where you meant to be.
A gremlin bumped the crystal mid-hop. Enjoy the detour!
Misfire! The thread took a shortcut through somewhere you haven't been.
The stone hiccuped. The Gremlins are writing this one down.

overlook.note: aha! this is where we found it.
survey: The Soft Stockroom ✓ (it's deeper than it looks)
overlook._master: The Overlook crystal is the Gremlins' master stone: from it you can hop to ANY section's plaza, even ones you haven't attuned.

_about_v3: v3 adds: lore (Grenshol + hooks for future clue notes), characters (hook for a future stats/dice-door system; not built), creature (Grenshol), minions (flitters), aliveMode (lights-change), stairwells (per-section stairChance), tvs, glimpse (the world behind the portal: glimpse.js + data/glimpse-world.json). Change names/lines freely; everything is read from here.

creature.name: Grenshol
creature._name: Bryan named it. Change here and it changes everywhere.
creature.about: A large, curious being from the other side of the portal. Never evil, never hurts anyone, never kills. It plays: peeks round corners, stands at the far end of hallways, sneaks up when you're not looking, and freezes like a cat on the counter when you look right at it.
creature._where: Only in deeper sections: never in excludeSections (the start), and never closer than minDepth cells to the entrance.

appear: Far down the hall, something very tall is standing very still.
The lights at the end of the hallway dim. Something is having a look at you.
A long, curious hum, somewhere close. Grenshol is around.
freeze: Grenshol freezes, like a cat caught on the counter. Quick! Tag it!
It goes completely still. It thinks you can't see it if it doesn't move.
It stops mid-step and pretends to be a coat rack.
flee: …and it folds itself into a doorway that wasn't there. Gone. For now.
It giggles like a kettle and slides away round the corner.
It ducks away. You hear it bump into something, very politely.
blink: It's behind you now. It wants to play.
A cool little breeze on your neck. Grenshol moved.

creature.caught: Grenshol got you! Long cool fingers, a curious hum, and the Annex folds away like a paper fan…
creature.tagged: You tagged Grenshol! It goes very still, then laughs like a kettle and opens the way to its home for you.

minions.name: flitters
minions.about: Grenshol's little moth-ish helpers. Mostly they flutter about. Sometimes one lands on an almost-person and drives it for a bit.
possessed: A flitter lands on an almost-person's head. Its eyes go a very bright blue.
Something small and fluttery climbs into an almost-person's ear. It straightens up and turns towards you.
lines: We are curious about your hands.
Hello, {nameOff}. Grenshol says hello. Grenshol says hello again.
What is a Tuesday. Show us a Tuesday.
Do you have a portal? We came out of one. It was very rude.
We like your walking. Do more walking.
release: It blinks. "Sorry. What was I saying? Was I saying?"
Its eyes go back to normal. A flitter bumbles off towards the ceiling.
It shakes its head like a wet dog and wanders back to its room.
minions.talkIntro: Its eyes are glowing blue. Something small and fluttery is doing the talking.

aliveMode.prompt: See what happens when the lights change?
aliveMode.switchTitle: A light switch that wasn't here before
aliveMode.switchLabel: A light switch that wasn't here before
aliveMode.small: Nothing bad happens. Things just get… livelier for a while.
aliveMode.on: Click. The lights go a strange blue. The chairs shuffle. Somewhere, something tall perks up.
aliveMode.off: The lights settle back to yellow. Everything pretends nothing happened.
aliveMode.decline: You leave it. The switch looks a little disappointed.

stairwells._about: Rooms in a section roll stairChance (per section row) for a stairwell. Kinds: up/down land you in another cell (or, otherSectionChance of the time, another section); loop puts you back at the bottom of the same stairs; flip lands you on an upside-down landing for a few seconds.

messages: You climb fourteen steps up and come out… on the same floor? Somewhere else, anyway: {section}.
Up, up, up. The stairs let out somewhere in {section}. Your ears pop politely.
Down the dark stairs, round a corner that shouldn't fit, and out into {section}.
You go down. And down. And come out on a floor that is definitely higher than where you started. {section}.
You climb up. You arrive at the bottom of the same stairs.
Up the stairs… and you're standing at the foot of them again. The poster looks smug.
You go up. The stairs go round. You are, once again, at the start of the stairs.
You come out on a landing that's upside down. The ceiling is the floor now. ({section}) Give it a moment.
Down the stairs and… everything's upside down. Your coffee isn't. ({section})

stairwells.loopNote: A gremlin note on the banister: "we went round 41 times. it's very good exercise."

tvs._about: Rooms of these types roll chance for a little TV. Each plays one procedural cartoon (picked by the room's hash) at fps frames per second, and only while it's on screen and within range metres.

_cartoons.stamper: a little figure stamping forms forever
_cartoons.sunclock: a smiling sun clocking in at 9:00, again
_cartoons.queue: a queue where the front person goes to the back
_cartoons.survey: a calm survey where only '5' stays still
_cartoons.coffee: a mug labelled MORE that keeps getting bigger

glimpse.tourText: You're seeing through Grenshol's eyes. It's showing you where it came from.
glimpse.exploreText: You caught Grenshol! It lets you wander its home for a little while.
glimpse.chooseText: It remembers you. It can take you back somewhere you've been, or somewhere new.
glimpse.thinText: The glimpse is thinning… Grenshol is about to send you back.
glimpse.returnText: …and Grenshol sets you down, very gently, in the Annex: {section}.
